Sandbox_AtmosphereEnabled_tooltip: Enable the experimental gloomy climate layer. Disable to use vanilla climate.
Sandbox_AtmosphereIntensity_tooltip: 0 preserves vanilla climate. 1 is the intended brooding look; 2 doubles the effect.
Sandbox_HazeDensity_tooltip: Controls the added thin haze, not naturally occurring fog. 0 adds none.
Sandbox_Darkness_tooltip: Adjusts daylight and ambient climate dimming. 0 leaves vanilla brightness.
Sandbox_ColdTint_tooltip: Subtle blue-gray outdoor tint with weaker indoor tint. 0 leaves natural light colors.
